heading: Friday, March 28, 2025
topLine: Alibaba releases QVQ-Max visual reasoning model.

items.headline: Alibaba releases QVQ-Max visual reasoning model
items.summary: QVQ-Max is Qwen's visual reasoning model, following QVQ-72B-Preview, aimed at reasoning over images and video such as diagram-based math problems. It is available in Qwen Chat.
